mentions.name: Tactus
mentions.description: An NES game being ported to Windows, Mac, and Linux as a native build that uses the developer's own NES emulator as middleware, lightly modified to support a widescreen view the original console cannot do. The same game code runs on both platforms, with the PC build signaling its emulator shell when switching game modes to drive the widescreen display. Physical cartridges now work, letting the game run on real NES hardware, and a Steam page with Steamworks SDK integration is planned once the developer's business paperwork is sorted.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been busily porting my NES game, Tactus, to Windows, Mac, and Linux as a "native" build. It's been fun to consume my own emulator as middleware, and then lightly modify it to support things like a widescreen view, which the original console definitely cannot do.
